column1: # figure: fig02 panel b, all-recurrent-genes version (fig02_b_gene_by_study_long_80.tsv)
# script: build_call_matrix_383.py (this folder), run 2026-10-19; same call logic as fig2_b in <analysis repo>/analyses/figure_data_exports/export_fig02_fig07.py

# population: 383 genes x 80 studies; scenario 'published, brain', study tier; genes = set study_brain of recurrent_sets.tsv (q_bh < 0.1; 383); studies with a list = the 72 representatives of recurrence.scenario_selection run on the 80-study inputs (RECURRENCE_NK=membership, RECURRENCE_EMPTY_LISTS=drop); empty-list studies (no gene is a hit, so every call is tested_not_hit or not_tested): Maschietto 2015 (25981335): universe M of 9093 genes; de Baumont 2015 (25487697): universe M of 9093 genes; Arion 2017 (28476208): universe M of 16652 genes; Harris 2008 (19088852): universe M of 17918 genes; Abdolmaleky 2019 (30468562): universe M of 16436 genes; Iwamoto 2004 (14743183): universe M of 7455 genes; Iwamoto 2005 (15563509): universe M of 10792 genes; Pai 2019 (own list) (31053723): universe M of 25105 genes

# scratch tree: work_call_matrix/repo (this folder): analyses/ = <analysis repo>/analyses (symlinks) with recurrence_fork.py as recurrence.py, the 80-study primary_lists.json and universes.json; data/lists = repo lists + derived_all_2026-10-14/lists/*_fdr05.tsv; data/universe_sets = schizophrenia-transcriptome-replication/data/universe_sets + snrna_universe_2026-10-14 + handcoding_2026-10-14 + derived__<pmid>.txt rebuilt as the union of derived_all_2026-10-14/universes/*__tested.tsv (Frohlich: the D13 union set union_snrna_1pct__39227716.txt, 22,985 genes); corpus/lineage.json = lineage_4f91.json

# genes ranked by n_lists_observed desc then gene over all genes of the scenario in recurrence_genes.tsv: gene_rank = that position; rank_within_383 = position among the 383 by the same ordering. gene_rank has gaps (max 778): the 383 are the q_bh < 0.1 genes, not the top 383 by count; ranks of the 383 run 1..778

# call: up/down/mixed = direction in the study's primary list (mixed = both within the study's union); tested_not_hit = gene in the list's tested universe M but not a hit; not_tested = outside it; hit_no_direction = hit with no stated direction; a gene on a study's list but outside its tested universe M is called not_tested (fig2_b, which made the current manuscript table, called these cells by their direction)
# study_id = PMID (or DOI key); studies are in the column order of the manuscript table (named cohort clusters, then year), the 8 empty-list studies after them in the order of base80_studies.tsv

# rows: 30640 = 383 genes x 80 studies; hits (up + down + mixed + hit_no_direction) equal n_lists_observed for all 383 genes (checked); direction counts equal the up/down/both/other_direction columns of recurrence_genes.tsv for all 383 genes (checked). CARTPT, NPY and NR4A3 in study 16236523 are not_tested because the gene is on the study's list but outside its tested universe
